The days were cold, the water was cold, and they told me to be careful.  
After only three days, they told me to go weed the fields.  
I refused, claiming it was a false accusation. Wearing ragged clothes,  
I held a hoe in my hand and went outside.

Without worry, I went outside and reached the East Sea.

I couldn’t distinguish right from wrong, but suddenly the workers  
chased me from all directions, saying this is my field, that is the field.  
When I crossed the field, the workers of that house followed me,

Lightning flashed and I crossed that field.

I tried to weed by myself, and I was extremely fortunate.

Name: 38_angered_crying lamenting_prague_scarf
Representative_Docs: ['In Prague, it was a quarter to five at the town hall when I volunteered for my golden maiden. When luck does not want to serve me, it moves away from me: what my heart loved, it will not love anymore. Where is the handkerchief I gave you, the one I used to wear, into which I embroidered my name in the corner? Take it out of your pocket, put it on the fire, let the ashes scatter in the air: so that people cannot say that I was once your beloved.', 'I always thought that military service was a joke: that I would be there for a week or two weeks, then come home again. A week, two weeks, or an hour: ah, only the Lord God knows, my dear parents, where I will perish! If I perish among the Turks or the French: how heavy-hearted my mother will be for her darling! Not so much my mother, but my beloved, the one who always carried me in her heart all this time. When he came to the gate, he twisted his handkerchief: Return to me, my beloved, dear Andulka, what I lent you. “I cannot return it, I am not obliged: let another one at the military return it to you, my golden Jenik.”', 'Departure. When I was leaving my dearest, the moon was shining high, oh God! the moon was shining high: look, my golden maiden, how far I already am, oh God! how far I already am. I was four furlongs of fields away from her, she still called after me, oh God! she still called after me: "Stay here, my golden lad! stay with us until morning, oh God! stay with us until morning." I began to make excuses to her that I had to feed the horses, oh God! that I had to feed the horses: she began to wipe her blue little eyes, oh God! her blue little eyes. Why then are you crying and lamenting yourself, when you still have me here? oh God! when you still have me here: only cry and lament yourself when you can no longer watch over me, oh God! when you can no longer watch over me.']
